modules.name: listProjects
modules.label: List Projects
modules.description: Returns the projects the API key has access to.

modules.name: getProjectComponents
modules.label: Get Project Components
modules.description: Returns the components (modules) available in a project.

modules.name: listContacts
modules.label: List Contacts
modules.description: Returns contacts from a contact component.

modules.name: getContact
modules.label: Get a Contact
modules.description: Retrieves a single contact by ID.

modules.name: createContact
modules.label: Create a Contact
modules.description: Creates a new contact.

modules.name: updateContact
modules.label: Update a Contact
modules.description: Updates attributes of an existing contact.

modules.name: deleteContact
modules.label: Delete a Contact
modules.description: Deletes a contact by ID.

modules.name: listOpportunities
modules.label: List Opportunities
modules.description: Returns opportunities from a kanban component.

modules.name: getOpportunity
modules.label: Get an Opportunity
modules.description: Retrieves a single opportunity by ID.

modules.name: createOpportunity
modules.label: Create an Opportunity
modules.description: Creates a new opportunity.

modules.name: updateOpportunity
modules.label: Update an Opportunity
modules.description: Updates attributes of an existing opportunity.

modules.name: deleteOpportunity
modules.label: Delete an Opportunity
modules.description: Deletes an opportunity by ID.

modules.name: associateContact
modules.label: Associate Contact to Opportunity
modules.description: Links a contact to an opportunity.

modules.name: dissociateContact
modules.label: Dissociate Contact from Opportunity
modules.description: Removes the linked contact from an opportunity.

modules.name: addProduct
modules.label: Add Product to Opportunity
modules.description: Adds a product line item to an opportunity.

modules.name: updateProduct
modules.label: Update Opportunity Product
modules.description: Updates a product line item on an opportunity.

modules.name: removeProduct
modules.label: Remove Opportunity Product
modules.description: Removes a product line item from an opportunity.

modules.name: createTask
modules.label: Create Task on Opportunity
modules.description: Creates a task on an opportunity.

modules.name: updateTask
modules.label: Update Opportunity Task
modules.description: Updates a task on an opportunity.

modules.name: removeTask
modules.label: Remove Opportunity Task
modules.description: Removes a task from an opportunity.

modules.name: watchEvents
modules.label: Watch Opportunity Events
modules.description: Triggers instantly when Bolten sends an opportunity webhook event.

modules.name: makeApiCall
modules.label: Make an API Call
modules.description: Performs an arbitrary authorized API call against the Bolten API.
